title: Name availability check — final rename to SPEKTRAN
context: Owner direction: drop the Open- prefix; want a HITRAN-style short, memorable, pronounceable name (project has spectroscopy roots and sources line data from HITRAN). Owner's first proposal FITRAN failed (GitHub user taken; one letter from HITRAN — affiliation-confusion risk in the exact target community). Two candidate batches screened.

fitran.reason: GitHub name taken; HITRAN one-letter confusion risk

syntran.reason: available but collides with the syntran language project (JeffIrwin/syntran); owner declined

opensensorsim.reason: available and previously adopted; owner requested non-Open-prefixed name

selected.name: SPEKTRAN

github_repo_search.result: 6 hits, all unrelated zero-star personal repos (school acronym 'spektranesger', EEG hobby projects); no active software project

general_search_confusion.result: No software named 'spektran'. Nearest names reviewed: Spektrix (ticketing SaaS), Spekfy (discontinued PM tool), Spektrik (hardware firm), SpektralSoft (web agency) — all distinct spellings and domains.

selected.rationale: HITRAN-family '-TRAN' suffix keeps the spectroscopic lineage the project draws its line data from; 'Spektral' root states the founding domain; the k-spelling makes the name globally unique. Two syllables, easy to say and remember. As the platform grows beyond spectroscopy the name functions as a brand, as HITRAN itself outgrew 'transmission'.

naming_history: OpenGasSpec (g1_report.json) -> OpenSensorSim (g1_rename_report.json) -> SPEKTRAN (this report, final per owner confirmation)
human_action_required: Register GitHub org/repo, PyPI package, HF org under 'spektran'. GitHub account 'spectramaster' authenticated locally; HF login still pending (hf auth login).
